Agent Name: WebSurfer

Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent made a factual error in Step 2 by incorrectly stating that Ingmar Bergman died in "London, United Kingdom." This contradicts the actual search results visible in the same response, which clearly show multiple authoritative sources (Wikipedia, PBS, Rotten Tomatoes, IMDb) confirming he died in "Färö, Sweden" (Fårö). The agent hallucinated a conflicting location (London) instead of accurately reporting the consensus found in the search snippets. This error was then propagated by the Planner in subsequent steps as a point of conflict, leading to unnecessary redundant searches.
